finalLens.title: Momentum Needs Hands
finalLens.intro: Around the table, you push the next step into view before anyone has settled who carries it.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can get things moving fast, but someone still needs to know what is theirs.
finalLens.deeper_read: A deadline, a loose end, and a stalled conversation can have you making the standard plain and pressing the work forward. That push is useful when it leaves a person holding the next piece; otherwise, the work may already be ready while the pressure keeps rising.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment you sharpen the task again after someone has already taken it.
finalLens.move: Before adding another push, write one person’s name beside the next piece of work.

finalLens.title: When It Grates
finalLens.intro: At the same point in your morning, you are ready to push through or change the order.
finalLens.pull_quote: When a routine starts scraping, you look for the one step that keeps making extra work.
finalLens.deeper_read: You notice the same small step sending you back to fix what should already be done. That irritation is useful: it shows where a familiar sequence has stopped helping, and where one clean adjustment could give your pace somewhere better to go.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment you repeat a step because it is familiar, then have to redo the next one.
finalLens.move: Switch the most troublesome repeated step today, and keep the change only if the next task runs cleaner.

finalLens.title: Once It Is Noticed
finalLens.intro: At the end of a project, praise reaches you and you answer with the part you made happen.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can say what I did without turning the moment into a bigger performance.
finalLens.deeper_read: When someone points out what you did, the next impulse may be to add another move or make the moment bigger. Say what was yours plainly, then let the finished work hold the room; confidence does not need an immediate follow-up.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment after praise when you start adding plans, promises, or a stronger next step.
finalLens.move: Name the part you made, then let the conversation end without adding a new promise.
